segments.title: Opening & Hype Train Surge
segments.notes: Case tests new text-to-speech bit triggers; Hype Train commandeers feed for extended freestyle countdown rap reaching level 3.

segments.title: Tyler on Celebrity Blockout Trend
segments.notes: In-studio contributor Tyler reads AP coverage of #Blockout2024 protest targeting celebrities over Gaza silence; devolves into potato liberation rhetoric.

segments.title: Trip Bradstein: Park Opinions & Avatar Encounter
segments.notes: Trip interviews park visitors: Big Mouth Billy Bass enthusiast, self-declared Avatar/tax attorney Guy Gilligan, Rob Alvey banning everyone from Cedar Point, Mr. Beast's haunted-teeth baseball card manager, and a shapeshifter sent by ShapeShifter Sips.

segments.title: Sammy Seven Elbows: Epstein Cloning Allegations
segments.notes: New correspondent Sammy Seven Elbows debuts reading Daily Mail article claiming Jeffrey Epstein cloned himself via transhumanist biotech; discusses victim genetic harvesting, black book names (Chris Tucker), and Nick Bryant's podcast allegations.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Crum Finally Wins
segments.notes: After 200+ debates and six-month Crumback arc, Crum beats Munch's score for first time; Munch suffers on-air breakdown, wanders studio for three minutes, returns bald.

segments.title: Post-Debate Aftermath & Ale Munchester
segments.notes: Bruce Green raids during Munch's collapse; amnesiac 'Ale Chrome Chester' / 'Ale Munchester' appears claiming not to be Munch; quick Bruce vs. Casem debate ties score again.

segments.title: Trent at the Movies: Trailers
segments.notes: Trent watches Suburban Commando, Dune: Prophecy, Wicked, and You're Cordially Invited trailers; debates Spider-Man Miles vs. Peter with Chris; Kendall gives thumbs up.

segments.title: Hype Train Returns: Level 5-6 Radiation
segments.notes: Hype Train reappears at level 2, escalates to level 5-6 with new graphics; auto-tune, Yankee Doodle remix, Seinfeld trap, Scorpion King persona, emotional damage/brain damage freestyles.

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Patreon Plug
segments.notes: Case thanks raiders, plugs Patreon with Cas, mentions French Romance game and Fee's prison bail; transitions to Jo Rogen Experience.

segments.title: Dual Joe Rogans: Worms, Void & GameStop
segments.notes: Two Joe Rogans discuss brain worms (psilocybin-secreting), void navigation, GameStop 60M investment, monkey face-ripping strength, cookie semantics, and ketamine boofing; worm commands raid to Herman the Worm song.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors flagship broadcast; manages chaotic studio through Hype Train surges, Crum's historic debate win, and dual Joe Rogan finale.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: recurring. Hijacks broadcast twice — first for extended countdown rap to level 3, later for level 5-6 auto-tuned radiation event with Scorpion King persona.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Conducts park interviews with Avatar tax attorney, Cedar Point banner Rob Alvey, Mr. Beast's haunted-teeth manager, and a forgetful shapeshifter.

characters.name: Sammy Seven Elbows
characters.notes: Debuts as new correspondent covering Epstein cloning conspiracy; later claims amnesia as 'Ale Chrome Chester' / 'Ale Munchester'.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Loses debate lead for first time in 200+ debates; suffers mental breakdown, wanders studio bald, returns as amnesiac 'Ale Munchester'.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Achieves historic first debate score victory over Munch after six-month Crumback arc; triggers Munch's collapse.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Confirms dog identity; admits producing everything alone; discusses weed-induced depression and cigarette-eating habit.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: correspondent. Hosts At the Movies from probation-mandated theater; watches trailers with Chris and Kendall; debates Spider-Man rankings.

episode_summary: Crum achieves his first debate victory over Munch in 200+ encounters, triggering Munch's on-air psychological collapse and temporary baldness. New correspondent Sammy Seven Elbows debuts with Epstein cloning conspiracy coverage before adopting an amnesiac alias. Trip Bradstein interviews a park Avatar, a Cedar Point banner, and a shapeshifter. Hype Train hits level 6 with auto-tuned Scorpion King radiation. The broadcast closes with dual Joe Rogans discussing brain worms, GameStop, and monkey face transplants before raiding to Herman the Worm.
